Tabs

A row of tabs. By default it is a tablist: one tab in the page's tab order, the arrow keys of its orientation moving between tabs, Enter or Space selecting.

Source
Overview
Specs
Accessibility

A row of tabs. By default it is a tablist: one tab in the page's tab order, the arrow keys of its orientation moving between tabs, Enter or Space selecting. With as="nav" the same look is a navigation of buttons or links, the current one marked aria-current="page". The row can carry content of its own before and after the tabs - an icon, a toolbar, a "+" button.

import { Tab, Tabs } from '@soroush.tech/design-system/Tabs'

;<Tabs value={value} onChange={setValue} textColor="secondary" color="secondary" aria-label="Items">
  <Tab value="one" label="Item One" />
  <Tab value="two" label="Item Two" icon={<Icon name="folder" size="sm" />} />
  <Tab value="three" label="Item Three" disabled />
</Tabs>

Tabs holds its own value (defaultValue) or takes it (value / onChange). To show a panel for each tab, put the tabs in a TabContext as a TabList - it links each tab to its TabPanel:

import { Tab, TabContext, TabList, TabPanel } from '@soroush.tech/design-system/Tabs'

;<TabContext value={value}>
  <TabList onChange={setValue} aria-label="Items">
    <Tab label="Item One" value="1" />
    <Tab label="Item Two" value="2" />
  </TabList>
  <TabPanel value="1">...</TabPanel>
  <TabPanel value="2">...</TabPanel>
</TabContext>

The family: Tabs, Tab, TabContext, TabList, TabPanel and TabScrollButton.

The content of Canvas. Choose another tab and this changes with it.

Customized

<ThemeProvider theme={customTheme}>
  <View width="30rem" maxWidth="100%">
    <Tabs
      aria-label="Customized"
      defaultValue={0}
      overflowBehavior="scroll"
      shouldShowScrollButtonsOnMobile
      slots={{ scrollButton: ArrowButton }}
    >
      {Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, index) => (
        <Tab key={index} value={index} label={`Item ${index + 1}`} />
      ))}
    </Tabs>
  </View>
</ThemeProvider>

Icon Positions

iconPosition - top when unset, then each side
Icon only - no label; title names it
Mixed in one row - every label on the same line
Below the label - labels on the row's first line
<Scenarios>
  <Scenario title="iconPosition - top when unset, then each side">
    <Tabs aria-label="Icon positions" defaultValue="unset">
      <Tab value="unset" label="unset" icon={icon('table', 'sm')} />
      {tabIconPositionTokens.map((position) => (
        <Tab
          key={position}
          value={position}
          label={position}
          icon={icon('folder', 'sm')}
          iconPosition={position}
        />
      ))}
    </Tabs>
  </Scenario>
  <Scenario title="Icon only - no label; title names it">
    <Tabs aria-label="Icon only" defaultValue="files">
      <Tab value="files" title="Files" icon={icon('folder', 'sm')} />
      <Tab value="code" title="Code" icon={icon('code', 'sm')} />
      <Tab value="history" title="History" icon={icon('history', 'sm')} />
    </Tabs>
  </Scenario>
  <Scenario title="Mixed in one row - every label on the same line">
    <Tabs aria-label="Mixed" defaultValue="plain">
      <Tab value="plain" label="Plain" />
      <Tab value="start" label="Start" icon={icon('folder', 'sm')} iconPosition="start" />
      <Tab value="top" label="Top" icon={icon('table', 'sm')} />
      <Tab value="end" label="End" icon={icon('link', 'sm')} iconPosition="end" />
    </Tabs>
  </Scenario>
  <Scenario title="Below the label - labels on the row's first line">
    <Tabs aria-label="Icons below" defaultValue="files">
      <Tab value="files" label="Files" icon={icon('folder', 'sm')} iconPosition="bottom" />
      <Tab value="code" label="Code" icon={icon('code', 'md')} iconPosition="bottom" />
      <Tab value="history" label="History" icon={icon('history')} iconPosition="bottom" />
    </Tabs>
  </Scenario>
</Scenarios>

Icon Sizes

Tabs size="sm", iconPosition="start" - an icon of every size
Tabs size="md", iconPosition="start" - an icon of every size
Tabs size="lg", iconPosition="start" - an icon of every size
Tabs size="sm", iconPosition="top" - an icon of every size
Tabs size="md", iconPosition="top" - an icon of every size
Tabs size="lg", iconPosition="top" - an icon of every size
<Scenarios>
  {(['start', 'top'] as const).flatMap((position) =>
    tabSizes.map((tabSize) => (
      <Scenario
        key={`${position}-${tabSize}`}
        title={`Tabs size="${tabSize}", iconPosition="${position}" - an icon of every size`}
      >
        <Tabs
          aria-label={`${position} icons, ${tabSize} tabs`}
          size={tabSize}
          defaultValue="unset"
        >
          {iconSizes.map((iconSize) => (
            <Tab
              key={iconSizeName(iconSize)}
              value={iconSizeName(iconSize)}
              label={`icon ${iconSizeName(iconSize)}`}
              icon={icon(position === 'top' ? 'table' : 'folder', iconSize)}
              iconPosition={position}
            />
          ))}
        </Tabs>
      </Scenario>
    ))
  )}
</Scenarios>

    <Scenario key={variant} title={`variant="${variant}"`}>
      <Tabs aria-label={`${variant} with icons`} variant={variant} defaultValue="start">

  ))}
  <Scenario title="fullWidth - the tabs share the row">
    <Tabs aria-label="Full width with icons" fullWidth defaultValue="start">
      <Tab value="start" label="Start" icon={icon('folder', 'sm')} iconPosition="start" />
      <Tab value="top" label="Top" icon={icon('table', 'sm')} />
      <Tab value="end" label="End" icon={icon('link', 'sm')} iconPosition="end" />
    </Tabs>
  </Scenario>
  <Scenario title='orientation="vertical"'>
    <Flex gap={4}>
      <Tabs aria-label="Vertical start icons" orientation="vertical" defaultValue="files">
        <Tab value="files" label="Files" icon={icon('folder', 'sm')} iconPosition="start" />
        <Tab value="code" label="Code" icon={icon('code', 'sm')} iconPosition="start" />
        <Tab
          value="history"
          label="History"
          icon={icon('history', 'sm')}
          iconPosition="start"
        />
      </Tabs>
      <Tabs aria-label="Vertical top icons" orientation="vertical" defaultValue="files">
        <Tab value="files" label="Files" icon={icon('folder', 'sm')} />
        <Tab value="code" label="Code" icon={icon('code', 'sm')} />
        <Tab value="history" label="History" icon={icon('history', 'sm')} />
      </Tabs>
    </Flex>
  </Scenario>
  <Scenario title='as="nav" - links'>
    <Tabs aria-label="Navigation with icons" as="nav" defaultValue="files">
      <Tab
        value="files"
        label="Files"
        href="#files"
        icon={icon('folder', 'sm')}
        iconPosition="start"
      />
      <Tab
        value="code"
        label="Code"
        href="#code"
        icon={icon('code', 'sm')}
        iconPosition="start"
      />
    </Tabs>
  </Scenario>
</Scenarios>

Icons With Every State

disabled
isWrapped - a long label on two lines
closeLabel - closable, with an icon
secondaryAction - a menu, with an icon
<Scenarios>
  <Scenario title="disabled">
    <Tabs aria-label="Disabled with icons" defaultValue="on">
      <Tab value="on" label="Enabled" icon={icon('folder', 'sm')} iconPosition="start" />
      <Tab
        value="off"
        label="Disabled"
        icon={icon('lock', 'sm')}
        iconPosition="start"
        disabled
      />
    </Tabs>
  </Scenario>
  <Scenario title="isWrapped - a long label on two lines">
    <Flex width="16rem">
      <Tabs aria-label="Wrapped with icons" fullWidth defaultValue="long">
        <Tab
          value="long"
          label="A label long enough to wrap"
          icon={icon('folder', 'sm')}
          iconPosition="start"
          isWrapped
        />
        <Tab value="top" label="Another long label here" icon={icon('table', 'sm')} isWrapped />
      </Tabs>
    </Flex>
  </Scenario>
  <Scenario title="closeLabel - closable, with an icon">
    <Tabs aria-label="Closable with icons" variant="boxed" defaultValue="button">
      <Tab
        value="button"
        label="Button"
        icon={icon('code', 'sm')}
        iconPosition="start"
        closeLabel="Close Button"
      />
      <Tab value="card" label="Card" icon={icon('table', 'sm')} closeLabel="Close Card" />
    </Tabs>
  </Scenario>
  <Scenario title="secondaryAction - a menu, with an icon">
    <Tabs aria-label="Secondary action with icons" variant="boxed" defaultValue="light">
      <Tab
        value="light"
        label="Light"
        icon={icon('visibility', 'sm')}
        iconPosition="start"
        secondaryAction={
          <Menu
            align="end"
            trigger={
              <Button size="sm" variant="text" aria-label="Light options">
                ⋮
              </Button>
            }
          >
            <MenuItem value="rename">Rename...</MenuItem>
          </Menu>
        }
      />
      <Tab value="dark" label="Dark" icon={icon('visibility', 'sm')} />
    </Tabs>
  </Scenario>
</Scenarios>

Overflow Menu

The layers panel.

const args: Partial<TabListProps> = {
  variant: 'underline',
  orientation: 'horizontal',
  color: 'primary',
  size: 'md',
  fullWidth: false,
  isCentered: false,
  shouldSelectOnFocus: false,
  overflowBehavior: 'menu',
  overflowLabel: 'More panels',
  'aria-label': 'Left panel',
}

<TabContext defaultValue="layers">
  <View width="18rem" maxWidth="100%" overflow="hidden" style={{ resize: 'horizontal' }}>
    <TabList {...args}>
      {panelValues.map((value) => (
        <Tab key={value} value={value} label={value[0].toUpperCase() + value.slice(1)} />
      ))}
    </TabList>
  </View>
  {panelValues.map((value) => (
    <TabPanel key={value} value={value} p={2}>
      <Typography>The {value} panel.</Typography>
    </TabPanel>
  ))}
</TabContext>
